BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE hybrid_planning_state_inbox (
 event_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
 student_id uuid NOT NULL,
 learning_path_id uuid NOT NULL,
 payload_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK(payload_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 event_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(event_json)='object'),
 received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);
CREATE TABLE hybrid_evaluation_work (
 student_id uuid NOT NULL,
 learning_path_id uuid NOT NULL,
 generation bigint NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
 processed_generation bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(processed_generation>=0 AND processed_generation<=generation),
 latest_event_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES hybrid_planning_state_inbox(event_id),
 next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 claim_token uuid NULL,
 lease_until timestamptz NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(student_id,learning_path_id),
 CHECK((claim_token IS NULL)=(lease_until IS NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX hybrid_evaluation_work_pending_idx ON hybrid_evaluation_work(next_attempt_at) WHERE generation>processed_generation;
CREATE TABLE hybrid_evaluation_job (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
 student_id uuid NOT NULL,
 learning_path_id uuid NOT NULL,
 snapshot_ref varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK(snapshot_ref ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK(policy_version='hybrid-replan-v1'),
 snapshot_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(snapshot_json)='object'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 UNIQUE(student_id,learning_path_id,snapshot_ref,policy_version)
);
CREATE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_evaluation_immutable() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'hybrid planning receipts and snapshots are immutable'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_inbox_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON hybrid_planning_state_inbox FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_evaluation_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_snapshot_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON hybrid_evaluation_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_evaluation_immutable();
COMMENT ON TABLE hybrid_planning_state_inbox IS 'Exact durable Student fact receipt; no path command.';
COMMENT ON TABLE hybrid_evaluation_job IS 'Unique coherent owner snapshot and policy input; evaluation and Student application remain separate.';
COMMIT;
